pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to MMOBlock: what it is, its modular architecture, target platforms (Paper/Folia), and how the major subsystems relate to each other. Links to all child sections for deeper exploration.

pages.title: Getting Started & Installation
pages.purpose: How to install MMOBlock on a Paper or Folia server, required dependencies (PlaceholderAPI, ModelEngine, etc.), plugin manifest details (paper-plugin.yml), and the MMOBlockLoader classpath bootstrap process.

pages.title: Module Structure
pages.purpose: Explains the multi-module Gradle project layout: mmoblock-api, plugin, nms-loader, nms-v* adapters, and platform modules. Describes how they fit together and why the separation exists.

pages.title: Plugin Lifecycle & Core Services
pages.purpose: Overview of how MMOBlock initializes, coordinates its services, and shuts down. Introduces the RuntimeCoordinator, ECS framework, and the main MMOBlock JavaPlugin class. Links to child pages for each major service.

pages.title: Startup & Shutdown Sequence
pages.purpose: Detailed walkthrough of onEnable() and onDisable(): NMS adapter resolution, database initialization, ECS task scheduling, persistence restore, and graceful cleanup of NMS entities.

pages.title: Entity Component System (ECS)
pages.purpose: Explains the ECS architecture used internally: EntityManager, SystemManager, SystemBase, and the built-in components (HologramComponent, InteractionComponent, LifespanComponent, PositionComponent) and systems (HologramSystem, InteractionSpawnSystem, InteractionRemoveSystem).

pages.title: Admin Commands
pages.purpose: Documents the /mmoblock command tree: block and node subcommands (place, remove, get, list), reload subcommands, the Remover Token mechanic, and Brigadier/legacy command registration.

pages.title: Block & Node Runtime
pages.purpose: Overview of how custom blocks and nodes are managed at runtime: placement, interaction, mining, respawn, and visual synchronization. Links to child pages for blocks and nodes separately.

pages.title: BlockRuntimeService — Block Lifecycle
pages.purpose: Deep dive into BlockRuntimeService: placement methods (place, placeNodeBlock, placeRandomNodeBlock), interaction and mining pipeline, look protection, respawn/safety logic (grounded support, hemmed-in check, proximity), and visual engine integration (Schematics, BdEngine, ModelEngine).

pages.title: NodeRuntimeService — Node Lifecycle
pages.purpose: Explains the Node concept (multi-block resource nodes), NodeRuntimeService, NodeDefinition, PlacedNode, NodeConfigService, NodeRepository, and the block-list hologram display with {block_lists} placeholder.

pages.title: Mining System & Drop System
pages.purpose: Covers MiningSystem (per-player progress tracking, throttling, eviction), RespawnSystem, DropSystem (drop types: MATERIAL/EXPERIENCE/COMMAND, per-player visibility, explosion velocity, glow/beam visual effects, rainbow cycle, Folia thread safety).

pages.title: Configuration System
pages.purpose: Overview of the YAML-based configuration system: the four config domains (blocks, drops, tools, lang), BlockConfigService loading pipeline, and how definitions are validated and reloaded. Links to child pages for each domain.

pages.title: Block Definitions (blocks/*.yml)
pages.purpose: Documents the block YAML schema: item, respawnTime, deadDelay, randomLocation, particleBreak, sound, breakAnimation, hitbox, modelType (block/bdengine/schematics/modelEngine), conditions, allowedTools, and the display/hologram section. Includes annotated examples.

pages.title: Drop Tables (drops/*.yml)
pages.purpose: Documents the drop YAML schema: material/experience/command drop types, probability (chances), quantity ranges, dropType (inventory/frontGround/centerGround), perPlayer, effectExplosion, effectBeam, and effectGlow. Includes annotated examples.

pages.title: Tools & Language Configuration
pages.purpose: Documents the tools/*.yml schema (ToolAction: clickNeeded, decreaseDurability, allowedDrops) and the lang/*.yml localization files (en-us, id-id, ja-jp). Explains how messageComponent() resolves localized strings with placeholders.

pages.title: Global Config (config.yml)
pages.purpose: Documents config.yml settings: debug, bStats, updateChecker, lang, extractDefaultAssets, interactionThrottleMs, database settings (H2/MySQL), progressbar format, and hologram packet tuning (maxUpdatesPerTick, spacing, offset).

pages.title: Visual Systems
pages.purpose: Overview of the visual rendering subsystems: holograms, fake blocks, schematics, BdEngine, and ModelEngine integration. Links to child pages for each renderer.

pages.title: Hologram System
pages.purpose: Deep dive into HologramRuntimeService: rendering pipeline (line resolution, layout calculation, backend selection), PacketNmsBackend (PacketSession, redundancy caching, throttled updates, proximity rescan), ECS integration, DisplayLine types (TEXT/ITEM/BLOCK), RenderState (ACTIVE/PROGRESS/DEAD), and animation tags (<anim:wave>, <anim:colors>, <anim:typewriter>, <anim:burn>).

pages.title: Fake Block & Schematic Rendering
pages.purpose: Explains FakeBlockRegistry, how fake block packets are sent via NmsAdapter (showFakeBlock/clearFakeBlock), FakeBlockPacketHandler Netty injection, and SchematicService (.schem/.schematic file loading, placeFacing, adjustPos, normal/dead states).

pages.title: BdEngine & ModelEngine Integration
pages.purpose: Covers BdEngineService (Block Display entity rendering, .bdengine model files, onSpawn/onClick animations, collision lists, size scaling), ModelEngine integration (model attachment, state animations, barrier collision), and the NmsAdapter packet-based BdEngine model system.

pages.title: NMS Abstraction Layer
pages.purpose: Overview of the NMS (Native Minecraft Server) abstraction strategy: why it exists, how NmsAdapterRegistry resolves the correct adapter at runtime, and the supported Minecraft versions. Links to child pages for the loader and version-specific adapters.

pages.title: NmsAdapter Interface & NmsAdapterRegistry
pages.purpose: Documents the NmsAdapter interface (all methods: spawnInteraction, removeInteraction, sendBreakAnimation, showFakeBlock, clearFakeBlock, upsertPacketHologram, upsertPacketBdEngineModel, applyEntityGlow, etc.), NmsAdapterRegistry version resolution algorithm (exact match → fallback), MappingType detection (Mojang vs Spigot), and ServiceLoader/JAR scanning.

pages.title: Version-Specific NMS Adapters
pages.purpose: Describes the per-version adapter modules (nms-v1_21_4, nms-v1_21_1, nms-v1_21_11, nms-v26_1, nms-v26_2, nms-mojang-v1_19_4, nms-mojang-v1_20_4, nms-spigot-v1_19_4, nms-spigot-v1_20_4), their NmsProvider pattern, FakeBlockPacketHandler Netty injection, and how each implements the NmsAdapter interface using direct NMS/CraftBukkit classes.

pages.title: Platform Abstraction (Paper & Folia)
pages.purpose: Explains the platform module: why a Scheduler abstraction is needed for Folia compatibility, the Scheduler interface, PaperScheduler (BukkitScheduler-backed), FoliaScheduler (region/entity/global schedulers), SchedulerTask, and PlatformSchedulerProvider.

pages.title: Persistence Layer
pages.purpose: Overview of the data persistence architecture: DatabaseManager (H2/MySQL via HikariCP), repositories (BlockRepository, RespawnRepository, NodeRepository), DataCache (Caffeine-backed), and the PersistenceSystem/PersistenceReadSystem ECS systems.

pages.title: Database Schema & Repositories
pages.purpose: Documents the SQL schema (mmoblock_block, mmoblock_respawn, mmoblock_node tables), column migration strategy, BlockRepository/RespawnRepository/NodeRepository CRUD operations, and H2 vs MySQL dialect differences.

pages.title: Caching & Async Persistence Systems
pages.purpose: Explains DataCache (Caffeine), the PersistenceReadSystem (async startup restore), PersistenceSystem (async save on block break/respawn), and the RespawnRepository for tracking respawn timestamps.

pages.title: Public API (mmoblock-api)
pages.purpose: Overview of the mmoblock-api module for third-party plugin developers: MMOBlockApi singleton, ApiProvider, BlockService, NodeService, events, and data model classes. Links to child pages for events and models.

pages.title: API Events
pages.purpose: Documents all public Bukkit events: BlockMineEvent (isCompleted, getDefinition), BlockPlaceEvent, BlockRemoveEvent, BlockRespawnEvent — their fields, when they fire, and how to listen to them.

pages.title: API Data Models & Services
pages.purpose: Documents the public API model classes (PlacedBlock, PlacedNode, BlockDefinition, NodeDefinition, ToolAction, DropEntry, DropType, DropBeam, DropGlow, ConditionDefinition, DisplayLine), result types (PlaceResult, NodePlaceResult), and how to use BlockService/NodeService to place or query blocks programmatically.
